dispatch: Session 182 pulled the vault back from silence: a Worker self-loop after Pages migration had left apex returning zero bytes while the origin held steady. The fix rewired `originFetch` by hostname, added a post-deploy liveness gate with auto-rollback, and confirmed 6/6 smoke — the forge sealed. A 23-item audit followed, shipping 7 of them: dead bundles cleared, edge errors redacted, rate limits sparked at the `/v/rum` boundary.
